data.body: [P2] Apply the rejection exemption to the earlier retirement audit too. If the first and only Invoke receives a proven rejection, `context.attempts` remains nonempty while legitimate retirement evidence contains no native attempts, events, or histories. The earlier `validate_retirement_evidence(..., allow_no_launches=not context.attempts)` consequently rejects that evidence and quarantines the target despite this exemption. Use potentially dispatched attempts when determining owned launch work and `allow_no_launches`, while still auditing created controls. Add a rejected-only case followed by another case on the same target; the added rejected-peer test does not cover this path.
